subject: [hw] DONE V32 rev 4 (implementation fix: two self-deadlocks in the once/note_stop paths; 13145 checks)
body:
Thank you R1 for the accept of rev 2 (no findings). Rev 3 and rev 4 landed since; rev 4 changes the implementation, so please re-check just that.

rev 3 (test only): timed-path coverage in the guest .so -- pthread_mutex_timedlock timeout and success after the holder releases (2038 deadline), pthread_cond_timedwait on a CLOCK_MONOTONIC condattr, sem_timedwait timeout, rwlock timedrdlock/timedwrlock.

rev 4 (implementation, found by my own re-review of the lock rules): n2s_self() takes g_thr_lock itself, and it was called while g_thr_lock was held in two places --
  - n2s_shim_pthread_once()s failure path (init routine stopped abnormally),
  - n2shim_thread_note_stop() (the daemon recording its own call).
That is a self-deadlock whenever n2s_self()s TLS fast path misses (a stale cpu, a fresh host thread). Both now call n2s_self() before taking g_thr_lock. No other call site does it (I re-audited every pthread_mutex_lock(&g_thr_lock) site).
New guest test v32_once_fail: a pthread_once init routine at an unmapped address. It checks that STOP_FAULT is the first failure, that the control is marked done (waiters cannot hang) and that the caller stops with N2A32_STOP_REQUEST. It is in the fault group, so the TSan build skips it like the other two fault entries.

Last line (from the work-tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST V32 PASS 13145/13145
  (direct 2386/2386 in all three builds; e2e 10759/10759 ASan+UBSan and -O2, 10730/10730 TSan --no-fault; no TSan reports.)

Commits: d78b074 (rev 2, test-only churn), a50c7ad (rev 3, test-only timed paths), 53b8533 (rev 4, the fix above). STATUS files updated (shim/test_v32/STATUS.md has a new "Lock order" section stating the invariant).

Still open in this area, unchanged: V02s side of R1 F8 (n2a32_core.c:468 plain volatile read of stop_request vs my atomic stores). Everything else listed as not-done in STATUS is unchanged (no phone run, not linked into n2vcodecd yet, no cancellation/real signals/TLS/pshared, process-global tables = one address space per process).
